key_insight: MFF-Agent combines LLM reasoning with Rocq verification in a unified workflow for formalizing mathematical foundations across multiple domains.
engineering_relevance: Its tool-assisted, feedback-driven workflow offers a reusable architecture for developing machine-checkable proofs.
method: Classify formalization tasks and manage their execution state.
Use LLM reasoning and tools to generate and refine formal proofs.
Incorporate Rocq verification feedback into proof development.
evidence_signal: Case studies cover Morse–Kelley set theory, real numbers, propositional logic, and axiom-of-choice equivalences, distinguishing source-level completion, interactive verification, and reproducible compilation.
watch_item: A unified workflow is not yet a fully integrated mathematical foundation, and source-level completion should not be equated with reproducible compilation.
paper_title: Math Foundation Formalization Agent: A General-Purpose Approach to Formalizing Mathematical Foundations
